item.input: How should I store coffee beans?
item.expected_answer: Store in an airtight container, away from light and heat, at room temperature. Use within 2-4 weeks of opening.
Our team is very friendly and would love to chat with you about anything you need.
All our single-origin beans are certified organic by the EU. Blends may contain non-organic beans — check individual product pages.
